description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Massor dhal and Yellow lentils be valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 30.09.2016
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates on specific commodities (lentils) and rescinds previous orders. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
